every_transactional_metric:
SELECT SUM(oi.sale_price) AS gross_revenue, SUM(IF(oi.status = 'Returned', oi.sale_price, 0)) AS returned_revenue, SUM(oi.sale_price) - SUM(IF(oi.status = 'Returned', oi.sale_price, 0)) AS net_revenue, SUM(p.cost) AS cogs, (SUM(oi.sale_price) - SUM(IF(oi.status = 'Returned', oi.sale_price, 0))) - SUM(p.cost) AS gross_margin, SAFE_DIVIDE((SUM(oi.sale_price) - SUM(IF(oi.status = 'Returned', oi.sale_price, 0))) - SUM(p.cost), SUM(oi.sale_price) - SUM(IF(oi.status = 'Returned', oi.sale_price, 0))) AS gross_margin_pct, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS orders, SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(oi.sale_price) - SUM(IF(oi.status = 'Returned', oi.sale_price, 0)), COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id)) AS aov, COUNT(*) AS items_sold, SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(oi.status = 'Returned'), COUNT(*)) AS return_rate, SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(oi.status = 'Cancelled'), COUNT(*)) AS cancellation_rate, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.user_id) AS purchasing_customers
FROM `test-project.apparel_ecom_raw.order_items` oi
JOIN `test-project.apparel_ecom_raw.products` p ON p.id = oi.product_id
JOIN `test-project.apparel_ecom_raw.users` u ON u.id = oi.user_id
LEFT JOIN `test-project.apparel_ecom_raw.distribution_centers` dc ON dc.id = p.distribution_center_id
time_day:

FROM `test-project.apparel_ecom_raw.order_items` oi

JOIN `test-project.apparel_ecom_raw.users` u ON u.id = oi.user_id
LEFT JOIN `test-project.apparel_ecom_raw.distribution_centers` dc ON dc.id = p.distribution_center_id
GROUP BY 1

sessions_plain:
WITH sessions AS (
  SELECT session_id, MIN(created_at) AS started,
         ANY_VALUE(traffic_source) AS traffic_source,
         LOGICAL_OR(event_type = 'purchase') AS converted
  FROM `test-project.apparel_ecom_raw.events` GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS sessions
FROM sessions
sessions_both_metrics_source_time:
WITH sessions AS (
  SELECT session_id, MIN(created_at) AS started,
         ANY_VALUE(traffic_source) AS traffic_source,
         LOGICAL_OR(event_type = 'purchase') AS converted
  FROM `test-project.apparel_ecom_raw.events` GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT DATE_TRUNC(DATE(started), WEEK(MONDAY)) AS session_started, traffic_source AS session_traffic_source, COUNT(*) AS sessions, SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(converted), COUNT(*)) AS session_conversion_rate
FROM sessions
WHERE started >= '2026-01-01' AND started <= '2026-01-31'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY sessions DESC
LIMIT 3

repeat_rate:
WITH first_orders AS (
  SELECT user_id, MIN(created_at) AS first_order_at
  FROM `test-project.apparel_ecom_raw.orders` GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM `test-project.apparel_ecom_raw.orders` o2
  WHERE o2.user_id = first_orders.user_id
    AND o2.created_at > first_orders.first_order_at
    AND o2.created_at <= first_orders.first_order_at + INTERVAL 90 DAY
)), COUNT(*)) AS repeat_purchase_rate_90d
FROM first_orders
